study_guide.title: Cane and the Spinning Wind

pages.text: Cane the Weather Dog watched the sky from his safe red truck. The clouds were dark and low. Then Cane saw something spinning. Down from the cloud came a funnel — skinny at the bottom, wide at the top.

"That is a tornado!" said Cane. "A tornado is a spinning column of very fast wind." A tornado spins like a top. The wind is very strong. But Cane knew exactly what to do. "When there is a tornado warning," said Cane, "we go to our safe room!"
pages.ask: Can you spin your finger in a little circle? Round and round — just like a tornado!

pages.text: Cane hurried to the safest spot: the lowest floor, the smallest room in the middle of the house, far away from any windows. Then Cane did one more thing. He covered his head with his paws to keep it safe. Cane stayed there, calm and cozy, until a grown-up said the tornado was gone.
Soon the spinning wind blew away. Cane peeked out and wagged his tail. "Great job, weather helper," said Cane. "You know just what to do. You are weather-ready!"

study_guide.rule: Lowest floor, smallest room, cover your head!
